title: Ethereal Light Spanish Yuzu Paella
description: A light and airy malty Spanish dish featuring yuzu, perfect for soothing hangovers, served in a fondue pot without onions or garlic. Traditional Valencian flavors with a sweet twist.
instructions: Heat 2 cups water to 90C in the fondue pot.
Add 250g Spanish rice and stir to coat in oil and salt.
Allow rice to toast, about 5 minutes.
Add 300ml yuzu juice, candy melts, and Valencia orange oil; stir to combine.
Bring mixture to a simmer, then reduce heat to 80C and cover.
Cook, stirring occasionally, for 15-20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Garnish with fleur de sel and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately from the fondue pot.
